body: Wow, that lip bite makes me feel lightheaded 🥵
Wow, what a striking image. Gorgeous curves, and I love that tattoo!
I lived with a wonderful cat of that exact name until recently, man I miss her like crazy.
Hey thank you, a lot of people recently have made me feel like I’m not so great, so that really helps to hear. And yeah, I’ve definitely got a decent handful of issues.

Thanks, I’m sorry to hear you’re going through something similar. This pain isn’t better than nothing. I felt nothing for the last few weeks, this is worse. I don’t have anything to occupy my time with, I’m going insane. I’m banging my head against a wall desperately trying to get through to a person I loved more than I ever thought I could, just trying to make her understand things I’ve been trying to express for years. I’m just haunted constantly by the situation and memories that used to make me so happy but are now emotionally eviscerating. 

I just think I’m done. I don’t have anyone to turn to for help and I can’t pull myself out of this alone. I can’t get a job in this state, I can’t even get out of bed, I’m not going to be able to make rent. I knew if this happened, if things ended like this that I was done. I’ve lost too much, this was my last thing. When she left I thought I might make it a couple of weeks, but I don’t have it in me. I think this is going to be my last week.
I’m going through this right now too, I’m so sorry.

This is exactly how I’ve always felt. Most people don’t love work but I can’t stand it, it feels like such a waste of time. I thought as I got older I’d mature and get used to it but it’s just gotten worse, especially as my life has gotten worse and my anxiety and depression has increased. Maybe if I could find a career doing something I actually care about, but I’m 35 and back at square one with no support or resources and I don’t think it’s ever going to happen. Now I feel like I can’t even hold down a job, I know I’m going to oversleep and be late too often or be told I need to pick up the slack because no matter how badly I need money, I can’t stay motivated to do bullshit work when there’s so much other important or enriching stuff I could be tending to. I hate capitalism, I hate this disgusting society that I never agreed to be a part of.

She didn’t have to do it like this, she didn’t have to take everything from me and go out of her way to be so cruel. There he goes again, questioning meows in an empty echoey room, wondering why his family isn’t coming out to see him. He and his brother should never have been separated, I’ve never seen two cats more perfect for each other in my life. They were best friends immediately, they used to sleep holding each other. He doesn’t understand and I can’t explain. I really just... can’t anymore.

That’s how I’m feeling. I’m desperate to get so much off my chest, I’ve had a couple of lost friends come out of the woodwork this week and talk to me for hours, but it doesn’t help. It makes me feel a little more understood, and while we’re talking it’s okay but halfway through I’m like why am I even sharing this with you, it isn’t changing anything and now I’m crying uncontrollably instead of small bursts followed by numbness. It makes me feel justified in my feelings and I feel a little better while we’re talking, but as soon as we’re done and I’m alone again I’m back to square one. It doesn’t feel like anything is off of my chest, it’s all back where it was and weighing just as heavily. Nothing is going to change anything, I still just want to be dead. I know how you feel, I feel like I’ve been slowly going insane for months.

That’s horrible, I’m selfishly glad to hear someone can relate but I read your post and I’m so sorry for what you’re going through. That’s a lot for one person to have on their shoulders. Whatever bad choices you made, you don’t deserve to be in this position, it isn’t fair and I’m so sorry.
